scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit -p shared/tsconfig.json && npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w shared && npm run test:integration -w backend
